title: Chat export: Teams will not sign in, Brno
scenario: The customer pastes chat transcripts with abbreviations, typos and guesses; a provider incident explains the time-outs, the engineer keeps the customer informed and a late chat line only guesses that the incident is over.

events.title: Closing summary
events.text: Hello Jana, closing summary: the time-outs came from the provider's sign-in incident between 10:40 and 16:10 UTC, and no change was needed on your side. Should it return, give me one UTC moment of a failure and I will take another look.
